Author: Ananda Sen

 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi

Aryan Singh @ Santosh Singh .... ....Petitioner(s) Vrs State of Jharkhand .... ....Opp. Party
---------
Coram : Sri Ananda Sen, J
---------
 For the Petitioner: Mr. Altamash Khan, Advocate
 For the State: Mr. Suraj Deo Munda, Advocate
 ---------
04/Dated: 15.05.2024
The petitioner, who is accused for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(2)(n),
417,504,506 of the Ipc and Section 6 of the Pocso Act, is praying for grant of regular bail, as he is
in custody since 05.12.2023.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The informant who is the victim on the date of occurrence was more than 17 and half years.
She stated that she got acquainted with this petitioner through face- book in September, 2022.
On 20.05.2023 this petitioner called the victim near river to meet her.
After one month the victim visited Chapi Chawk to meet this petitioner then they have gone from Latehar to Manika to Kumandi station by motorcycle.
In the meantime due to night, she was taken to the house of one friend of this petitioner and kept there.
It is alleged that on the point of weapon, physical relationship was established.
On the next day, this petitioner dropped the victim at Chapi Chowk from where she returned and narrated the story to her parents.
Surprisingly the FIR was registered on 24.11.2023 after a long delay.
Learned APP opposes the prayer for bail.
Considering the aforesaid facts and the delay in lodging the FIR, I am inclined to allow this application.

Accordingly, the petitioner above named is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the Aryan Singh @ Santosh Singh vs Vrs on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70106982/
1 satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Lohardaga in connection with Kuru P.S. Case No. 131 of 2023, corresponding to Spl. POCSO No. 5 of 2024.
